title: Denied Boarding Compensation Scale — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Conditions of carriage, annex on involuntary denied boarding.** The compensation scale is the same on all six fare brands of Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand. Lateness is the arrival lateness of the alternate transportation Crestline arranges, compared with the original scheduled arrival.

| Fare brand | No compensation below (hours late) | Lower band upper limit, domestic (hours) | Lower band upper limit, international (hours) | Lower band, percent of one-way segment fare | Lower band cap (USD) | Upper band, percent of one-way segment fare | Upper band cap (USD) | Voucher uplift over cash (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 1 | 2 | 4 | 200 | 1075 | 400 | 2150 | 25 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 1 | 2 | 4 | 200 | 1075 | 400 | 2150 | 25 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 1 | 2 | 4 | 200 | 1075 | 400 | 2150 | 25 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 1 | 2 | 4 | 200 | 1075 | 400 | 2150 | 25 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 1 | 2 | 4 | 200 | 1075 | 400 | 2150 | 25 |
| Crestline First | 1 | 2 | 4 | 200 | 1075 | 400 | 2150 | 25 |

## Band boundaries

| Arrival lateness of the alternate transportation | Domestic flight | International flight |
|---|---|---|
| Less than 1 hour | No compensation | No compensation |
| 1 hour up to and including the lower band limit | Lower band (limit 2 hours) | Lower band (limit 4 hours) |
| Beyond the lower band limit, or no alternate transportation offered | Upper band | Upper band |

The voucher uplift is the increase over the cash amount when the passenger chooses a Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher instead of cash.
